series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, muted earth/stone/bronze midtones, deep ink-navy shadows)

scenes.shot_type: Outer Basalt Sea-Fangs & Perpetual Twilight Strait Entering the Shadow Lands (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm low-angle coastal wide: jagged wet black basalt sea-fangs & creeping fog framing oil-black strait as ink-navy twilight clouds swallow bruised-amber horizon

scenes.shot_type: Bronze-Age Navigator Bow OTS Approaching Razor-Toothed Shadow Mountains (40mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm ship-bow OTS: cloaked Bronze-Age navigator with brass lantern staring across dead oil-black water toward jagged Shadow Lands peaks in pallid slate-green fog

scenes.shot_type: Poison-Black River Ash Wilderness Gorge & Pale Ghost-Grass Banks (28mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm Shadow Lands gorge wide: sluggish poison-black River Ash winding between barren black shale & dead bone-pale ghost-grass stalks under toxic twilight mist

scenes.shot_type: High-Elevation Shadow Lands Gorge-Mouth First Revealing Distant Asshai (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm high cliffside ultra-wide: serpentine ink-black River Ash creeping out of towering Shadow Mountain chasm toward distant misty silhouette of Asshai's walls

scenes.shot_type: Central River Ash Canal & Greasy Black Stone Monoliths of Asshai (50mm Master Anchor)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm canal-level reveal matching ANCHOR-IMG0095: lone hooded figure poling black skiff between stepped greasy black stone pylons & dim crimson lanterns under twilight

scenes.shot_type: Stupendous Cyclopean Harbor Walls, Megalithic Water-Gate & Stepped Pyramids of Asshai (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm harbor panorama: miles of battered greasy black stone sea-walls, megalithic canal gate & endless stepped pyramids dwarfing two dark-sailed Bronze-Age ships

scenes.shot_type: Towering Jointless Black Monoliths Dwarfing Two Masked Lantern-Bearers on Wet Quay (65mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm vertical telephoto study: soaring unadorned greasy black stone monoliths above wet canal quay dwarfing two adult hooded masked figures with dim crimson lantern

scenes.shot_type: Crimson-Masked Shadowbinder Crossing Seamless Pre-Human Black Plaza (50mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm courtyard medium: solitary crimson-masked adult shadowbinder crossing rain-slicked plaza of seamless eroded greasy black stone monoliths

scenes.shot_type: Silent Tomb-Like Street Canyon of Empty Black Palaces Without Children (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm street-canyon wide: vast deserted avenue of dark uninhabited greasy black stone palace portals with three distant isolated adult masked figures & zero children

scenes.shot_type: Tactile Close Study of Flame Held Against Light-Drinking Greasy Black Stone (85mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm close texture study: gloved Asshai'i hand holding iron fire-cresset inches from waxy unadorned greasy black stone wall that swallows the light into darkness
